description: Upload an image to Prizmad and get back a prizmad.com-hosted URL the caller can plug into productImages or avatarImageUrl. Accepts either a public image URL we can fetch, or a base64-encoded blob (with optional `mimeType`). The image is auto-rotated, resized to fit a 2048×2048 box, and re-encoded as WebP — the original format does not need to be WebP. Max 20 MB.

base64Data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (with or without a `data:image/...;base64,` prefix). Either imageUrl or base64Data is required.

imageUrl.description: Publicly fetchable https/http URL of the image. Either imageUrl or base64Data is required.

mimeType.description: MIME type for base64Data. Ignored when imageUrl is provided. Defaults to inference from the data URL prefix.

name: upload_image
